blocks.title: Preparation
blocks.content: Retained proposed preparation: 5 minutes walking/marching; 10 bodyweight squats; 8 unloaded hinges; 8 scapular pull-ups OR shoulder-blade movements; 8 arm circles each direction. First loaded lower-body pattern: 2–4 progressively loaded warm-up sets; each new upper-body pattern: 1–2 light sets as needed; no failure. Bodyweight squats/unloaded hinges are preparation, not working squat/RDL prescriptions.
